subject: expression: remove inner context cache in `expression.ScalarFunction` (#48940)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focused on `pkg/expression/*` and `pkg/planner/core/scalar_subq_expression.go`: this commit removes the cached `sessionctx.Context` field from `expression.ScalarFunction` and deletes the deprecated `EvalWithInnerCtx`/`GetCtx` plumbing, updating constructors and `Constant` deferred-eval to require the caller-supplied ctx. No Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics/session-behavior issues found in the touched logic; the change is a mechanical removal of deprecated context-caching with no remaining `EvalWithInnerCtx` usage in-tree.
